page_title: ROM 2-1 COM | AS Roma v Como 02/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van der Brempt I. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Jonathan Ikone (Como) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Jean Butez pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
89' Patrick Cutrone (Como) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the middle of the goal, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Mile Svilar. What a save!
89' OFF THE POST! Mergim Vojvoda (Como) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post!
86' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) picks up a yellow card.
86' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) gets booked for the first time in this match.
85' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
85' Jonathan Ikone (Como) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
84' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nico Paz departs the field of play to be replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Como).

81' Alieu Fadera (Como) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Luca Pairetto stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. AS Roma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
80' Alieu Fadera (Como) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
80' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
76' 2 - 1 It's 2:1! Devyne Rensch feeds Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the left side of the net.
75' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
74' Substitution. Zeki Celik makes way for Devyne Rensch (AS Roma).
74' Dani Guindos has decided to substitute Alex Valle and he is replaced by Alberto Moreno (Como).
74' Substitution. Alieu Fadera (Como) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Assane Diao walks off.
70' A goal, which was scored by Assane Diao (Como), was disallowed due to offside.
69' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) receives a yellow card!
66' Como enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
63' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) sees a yellow card in the hand of Luca Pairetto. And as it's a second one this game, a red follows and Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) is sent from the pitch.
61' 1 - 1 A sweet pass is collected by Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) inside the penalty box and he unleashes a brilliant shot which goes into the roof of the net and behind the goalkeeper.
60' Manu Kone goes off the pitch and Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) comes on.
59' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Matias Soule will be replaced by Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma).
58' Patrick Cutrone (Como) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Mile Svilar pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
56' Here is a change. Maxence Caqueret is going off and Dani Guindos gives the last tactical orders to Patrick Cutrone (Como).
56' It is time for a substitution. Mergim Vojvoda (Como) is on for Ivan Smolcic.
54' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) earns the yellow card.
51' Maxence Caqueret (Como) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
49' Luca Pairetto interrupts the game. One of the players from Como won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
49' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Claudio Ranieri has made a change at the break. Artem Dovbyk has come on in place of Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Lorenzo Pellegrini is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 1 Goal! Maximo Perrone passes the ball to the feet of Lucas Da Cunha (Como), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:1.
42' Alex Valle (Como) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
39' Como control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
36' Some neat passing and movement from Como as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
34' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
33' The foul by Gabriel Strefezza (Como) was seen by Luca Pairetto who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. AS Roma earn a free kick.
32' Angelino (AS Roma) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Como in a dangerous position.
31' A pass into the box finds Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Jean Butez denies him.
27' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
27' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Luca Pairetto no option but to blow his whistle.
25' Neat passing move from Como in order to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Ivan Smolcic (Como) dummies a defender then lets fly from the edge of the box, but the ball misses the left post by a mile.
20' The linesman raises his flag. Assane Diao (Como) is adjudged offside.
18' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
16' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) brings his opponent down. Luca Pairetto has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Como.
15' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is able to continue to play.
14' The game is interrupted now, Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
13' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle and signals a foul after Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) brought his opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Como.
12' Ivan Smolcic (Como) is the one who receives a yellow card.
10' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
6' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Como.
3' The AS Roma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has started.
AS Roma will kick-off.
Luca Pairetto is the one to supervise the game today.
